text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Bourbon-san! I want to
get to know more about you...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
............
I do not grasp your intent. Why?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... Even though we share a room,
there's still so much I don't know about you, which makes me feel a bit lonely...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So... oh, I know! I want you to take me
to your favorite place, Bourbon-san!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I see. I understand your reasoning.
I will grant your request.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, the journey to my "favorite place" is a bit strenuous. Will you be alright?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!
I'll do my best wherever you put me!

And so, acting as their chaperone,
I came along to climb the mountain
recommended by Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I can hear so many birds chirping...
What a wonderful place!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. While rich in nature,
it's also well-maintained for climbers.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, there is a sweet shop at the summit
perfect for replenishing energy after the climb, and it is exceedingly delicious.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Is that right!
Wow, I can't wait~!

After climbing for several hours, we finally saw
a sign that read, "100m to the summit."
However—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Irregular breathing detected from Flower-san. Are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm okay, really!
I'm sorry, ehehe—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Kyaah!?
Nishino Flower lost her balance and fell down...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...It appears she sprained her anterior talofibular ligament. She will recover
in a few hours, but reaching the summit is impossible for her right now."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I-If that's the case, I'll wait here!
Please, go see the summit together, the two of you!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Rejected due to associated risks.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Master, there is a downhill lift near here.
Let us move there.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“But...
After coming this far...!”

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "Or, if it is me, I could carry her on my back all the way to the summit."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh, no, not at all—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Order acknowledged. Searching for a lift.
Let us go, Nishino Flower-san.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... I ruined everything, both the hike and the dessert afterward...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Accessing data logs.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
At the foot of the mountain, there's a popular
Japanese sweets shop that opened a month ago.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Our popular menu item is the shiratama cream zenzai.
It's a masterpiece made with Ogura red bean paste and fruits from Yamagata.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Shall we stop by, Master?
Afterward, just as Mihono Bourbon had said, there was a brand-new Japanese sweets shop at the foot of the hill.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~, so delicious...!
It's so fluffy and chewy...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Relaxation effect from high-quality sugar intake confirmed.
Considering utilizing again.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: When that time comes, by all means, Nishino Flower should join us too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Yes, by all means...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order received. Setting course for the summit.
Nishino Flower-san, please get on my back.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much... But
I can't impose on you any further...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, as the experienced one here, the fact that I failed
to grasp your physical condition was the root cause to begin with.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, with my muscle strength, someone of your weight
is well within my payload capacity. It is by no means a "bother."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: B-But—

When I gently encouraged Nishino Flower, who was still hesitating,
she fell silent for a moment before finally giving a small nod.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Ha, ha, ha.

And so, after aiming for the top for about thirty minutes—
we safely reached the summit.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Incredible...! It's completely deep blue...!

Nishino Flower was utterly captivated
by the breathtaking blue scenery spread out below the peak.
And then, on the way home—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...I know I said I'd wait,
but deep down inside,
I really wanted to climb all the way to the top.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe.
Bourbon-san, thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No.
...The scenery was especially lovely today.
